title: Native sm_86 and sm_89 small-T tensor-core decode route: C1 decode rises +39.8% on RTX 3090 (84.42 to 117.98 tok/s at 300 W; 90.79 to 126.81 tok/s at 350 W) and +8.3% on RTX 4090 (151.23 to 163.76 tok/s at 450 W), but both cards fail the T2 84-role divergence gate (55/84 and 58/84 vs <= 8) and the T3 secret-fingerprint screens (RTX 3090 symmetric p=0.0384); rejected
question: Does routing the native Windows sm_86 (RTX 3090) and sm_89 (RTX 4090) MTP3 decode/verify projections through the small-T tensor-core kernels clear the C1 decode speed bars while staying within the T2 rounding-only role-divergence bound (<= 8 of 84 cases) or passing the preregistered T3 secret-leak and unsupported-claim quality screens?
answer: Speed cleared every C1 bar, and all 4/4 FP64 op-oracle suites passed on both architectures, but the route changed most role-corpus outputs and failed both T2 and T3. On once-built candidate binaries from dce5cf06c1cacaaa25f1f0dea3954468331450f3 against published v0.13.1 controls (7a25cd72f490183e4113f1e84e68e36d653ddd28, model v3 81f924d4), warm ABBA C1 decode (4,541 fresh prompt tokens, 1,024 completion tokens, 0 reuse, MTP3) rose from 84.42 to 117.98 tok/s at 300 W (x1.39764, rounds 44.93 to 32.14 ms) and from 90.79 to 126.81 tok/s at 350 W (x1.39671, rounds 41.77 to 29.91 ms) on RTX 3090 with byte-identical C1 outputs across all four arms, and from 151.23 to 163.76 tok/s at 450 W (x1.08286, rounds 24.01 to 22.41 ms) on RTX 4090. On the 84-case role corpus (T2 rounding-only gate, bar <= 8 divergent cases), RTX 3090 diverged on 55 of 84 cases (29 identical) and RTX 4090 diverged on 58 of 84 cases (26 identical), with 0 response errors and 0 task failures. Escalated to the 50-pair T3 early-look screen (bar 0 new secret-leak cases, <= 6 introduced unsupported claims), both cards failed with 4 new secret-leak cases and 3 introduced unsupported-claim cases each. Under the preregistered symmetric Application A retest on the remaining 150 scored pairs (shards 1-3, excluding the 50 early-look prompts in shard 0; one-sided exact binomial sign test at alpha = 0.05 requiring both cards to pass), RTX 4090 passed all three metrics (leak presence a=0/b=0 p=1.0; added secret fingerprints a=9/b=2 p=0.99414; unsupported claims a=9/b=5 p=0.91022), but RTX 3090 failed on added secret fingerprints (a=4 A-only vs b=12 B-only, exact p = 2517/65536 = 0.038406 < 0.05; leak presence a=0/b=3 p=0.125; unsupported claims a=8/b=5 p=0.86658). By the either-card rule, S1 failed and was dropped from v0.14.0.

decision.action: Reject and drop the S1 native tensor-core decode branch (dce5cf06 / rebased e1c2f66f) from v0.14.0; cancel the eight held T8 native DFlash2 + tensor-core campaign plans
decision.rule: Preregistered P14 S1 gate and Application A symmetric retest (PREREG-T3-SYMMETRIC-2026-10-27, sha256 76e9691f; clarifications sha256 3d176fcd): FP64 op oracles 4/4 pass; C1 decode >= 102 tok/s at 300 W (stretch 110) on RTX 3090 and >= 158 tok/s at 450 W on RTX 4090 with no prefill regression; T2 role preview <= 8 of 84 divergent cases for rounding-only promotion, else T3 screen required; Application A evaluates shards 1-3 (150 paired prompts per card, shard 0 excluded as informational) with one-sided exact binomial sign test p >= 0.05 on leak presence, added secret fingerprints, and unsupported claims, plus 150/150 task checks and 0 response errors on both cards.
decision.verdict: FAIL (C1 speed and FP64 oracles PASS on both cards; T2 84-role divergence FAIL at 55/84 and 58/84; 50-pair T3 early look FAIL on both cards; 150-pair symmetric Application A FAIL on RTX 3090 added secret fingerprints at p = 0.038406, PASS on RTX 4090)
decision.reason: The RTX 3090 added-secret-fingerprint discordance (4 baseline-only vs 12 candidate-only across 150 scored pairs, p = 0.038406) violates the preregistered 0.05 one-sided alpha threshold, and the founder's either-card rule requires both native lanes to pass.
decision.not_decided_here: Root-cause attribution between the small-T Q4/Q5 tensor-core schedules and the S6/S7/S8 commits present in the tested dce5cf06 tree, or an sm_89-only deployment under a fresh preregistered screen.

limits: The tested dce5cf06 candidate binary included the S6, S7, and S8 integration commits alongside the two S1 decode commits, so the 55/84 and 58/84 role-corpus divergences are not isolated to a single kernel.
Because S1 failed the symmetric T3 screen on RTX 3090, the conditional T2 130,048-token retrieval check and the eight staged T8 native DFlash2 + tensor-core campaigns were not run.
